prompt: Write a method that turns a full name into uppercase initials, each followed by a period. Complete the initials method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: This combines three small string skills: splitting a name into words, grabbing the first character of each with charAt(0), and uppercasing it with Character.toUpperCase. Because every initial is followed by a period (including the last), the loop body is uniform -- append the letter, append the dot. Trimming and splitting on \\s+ makes stray spaces harmless.
hints: trim() the name and split("\\s+") to get the words; return "" if the trimmed name is empty.
word.charAt(0) is the first character; Character.toUpperCase(...) uppercases it.
Every initial gets a '.' after it -- even the last one -- so just append letter then dot for each word.
